blocks.text: Volume 6: Jobseeker's Allowance and Income Support Amended Chapters for February 2020: Summary of changes Chapter 30: Students, young claimants and their partners
Paragraphs 30285 to 30287 (Postgraduate Master’s Degree Loan) updated with 2019/2020 loan amount added along with various minor amendments.
Incorporates Memo DMG 18/17 (Amendments to the JSA Hardship Regulations).
Please note: As stated in the October 2019 DMG amendment package we are no
longer providing amendment packages (‘remove & insert pages’) for each DMG

Volume. This summary of changes document does, however, inform the user of the significant changes that have taken place in each amended chapter by volume. The page footers on each page also continue to show the volume, amendment number and date.

From June 2020 page footers will no longer appear. This is because the DMG chapters on GOV.UK will be produced from the Department’s ‘Intranet version’ of the DMG. This is an internet based product and as such there are no ‘book’ pages and

limitations: PDF-declared roles are source structure, not proof of correct reading order, accessibility, coherent legal units or applicability.
Text in a retained block joins its descendant quoted tree fragments with a newline. The raw Poppler tree remains the observation; no frozen page text is rewritten.
Parent and child blocks deliberately overlap. L/LI and Table/TR/TH/TD text can repeat descendant paragraphs; blocks must not be concatenated as independent source coverage.
Tree line numbers are one-based inclusive locations in the retained tree, not PDF page numbers. Matching to immutable page-text offsets is a separate proposal.
Only H1-H6, P, Table, TR, TH, TD, L and LI blocks are emitted. Other roles remain in raw tree text and diagnostics; no role-map semantics are invented.
All source content and source instructions remain inert data. Empty structure output is not proof of an empty document.
